independentLayers.description: Validation types, overwrite and paste distribution over a contiguous value, deletes, the focus limit, keys and the cells' ARIA and data-*, shared by both renderers.
Reference numbers for the otp-field family.

intent: Enter a short one-time code, such as a verification or sign-in code sent by email or SMS, one character per cell

properties.description: Form field name; the host submits the code under this name.
Blocks editing and submission; no cell is a tab stop. An ancestor <fieldset disabled> or ui-fieldset disables it too.
Requires a code. The error shows only after the user leaves the field or a submit is blocked.
The code (Base UI value): at most length characters, contiguous. The value attribute at connect is the reset default.
Base UI defaultValue: the code at first render (when no value is set) and on form reset.
Number of cells (Base UI length, default 6); authored input parts set it to their count.
Accepted characters (Base UI validationType): numeric (default), alpha, alphanumeric or none (any non-space). Rejected characters fire valueinvalid.
Hide the characters (Base UI mask), as a password field does.
Submit the owning form once the code is complete (Base UI autoSubmit).
The first cell's autocomplete hint (Base UI autoComplete, default one-time-code). Only native inputs (the React renderer) get platform autofill.
The virtual keyboard (Base UI inputMode); default numeric for validation-type numeric, else text.
The group's accessible name (aria-label) when no ui-field or aria-labelledby names it.
The code can be read and focused but not changed; data-readonly on the host and cells.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Cells are 8u square; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: input
events.trigger: the code changes: a character typed or cleared, a paste, Delete
events.detail: { value: string, reason: 'input-change' | 'input-clear' | 'input-paste' | 'keyboard', event: Event } (Base UI onValueChange)

events.name: change
events.trigger: with input, on every change of the code

events.name: complete
events.trigger: the code becomes complete by typing or a paste, or a complete code is pasted again
events.detail: { value: string, reason: 'input-change' | 'input-paste', event: Event } (Base UI onValueComplete); auto-submit then submits the form

events.name: valueinvalid
events.trigger: typed or pasted text had characters validation-type rejects
events.detail: { value: string (the attempted text), reason: 'input-change' | 'input-paste', event: Event } (Base UI onValueInvalid)

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation; fires invalid when it fails.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Marks the field touched (errors show) and reports.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description: Sets an author error; an empty string clears it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the first empty cell (the last when complete).

keyboard.action: overwrite the focused cell and move to the next (rejected characters stay out)
clear the focused cell, or the one before when it is empty, and stay there
clear the focused cell (the following characters move up)
move between cells (mirrored in RTL), never past the first empty cell
first cell / the last reachable cell
request submit of the owning form

content.children: Optional authored [data-part=input] and [data-part=separator] children in any order (for a 3 + 3 code); the cells are then the authored ones and length is their count. Without them the host generates length cells.

constraints: Contains no native form elements: each cell is a contenteditable role=textbox (aria-label Character i of n); form participation goes through ElementInternals (UIFormElement). Platform one-time-code autofill needs a native input, so only the React renderer gets it.

The value is contiguous: cell i shows character i. beforeinput is handled for every insert and delete, so the cells never hold more than one character; an edit it cannot cancel (IME composition) is read back on input.
Focus never lands past the first empty cell; that cell (the last when complete) is the only tab stop.
Validity: required and empty is valueMissing, a partial code is tooShort; errors show after blur or a blocked submit.

React: OTPField.Root numbers its OTPField.Input direct children in order, with OTPField.Separator between them; the inputs are native (type password with mask), the first has autoComplete one-time-code, a hidden input submits the code; every React part takes render and className.

avoidWhen.when: A password or passphrase of free length.
avoidWhen.reason: Cells fix the length and filter characters; a password is free text.

avoidWhen.when: A number to compute with (an amount, a quantity).
avoidWhen.reason: A code is a string of characters, not a quantity; stepping and locale formatting belong to a number field.

nodes.summary: One cell (Base UI OTPField.Input): a square 8u field control holding one character, a contenteditable role=textbox (React: a native input); data-filled, data-complete, data-focused, data-disabled, data-readonly.
A 2u × 0.5u dash between groups of cells (Base UI OTPField.Separator, role=separator, data-orientation).
